attributes.name: Soulshear
attributes.powers: For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 1d10+4. If not proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4. if you fail this check, you may discard this card to reroll the dice; take the new result. If you reroll the dice and this card has the Corrupted trait, roll 1d12; on a 1, after the check, summon and defeat this adventure's servitor demon or shuffle Soulshear into your location deck.

corrections.corrected_text: On the loot Soulshear, change "on a 1, summon and defeat this adventure’s servitor demon" to "on a 1, after the check, summon and defeat this adventure's servitor demon".
corrections.issue: Soulshear can make me summon a demon after I use its reroll power. Should I finish the current check before I do that?
